title: Domaine des Vignes
area: La Moutte, between the village and the beaches
features: Main house with four en suite bedrooms
short: Two Provençal houses among umbrella pines and vines in La Moutte, minutes from the village and the sea.
long: In La Moutte, the quietest corner of the peninsula, two Provençal houses stand within more than a hectare of lawn, umbrella pines and vines. The main house keeps a lounge, a dining room and four bedrooms, each with its own bathroom. Across the garden, a guest house of three bedrooms lives entirely on its own terms. A heated pool and pool house sit low in the grass. The village and the beaches are close, yet nothing here is heard but the pines.
source_agency: Michaël Zingraf Real Estate (co-listed by Côte d'Azur Sotheby's International Realty, ref CA9-1121)

title: Mas Blanc
area: Gated residential domain, views over green hills
features: Five bedrooms including a master suite with study and dressing room
Spa with gym, sauna and hammam
short: A white house of stone, lime and old wood above a long green pool, in a quiet Mougins domain.
long: Set within one of the most private domains in Mougins, this villa has been renewed in a warm Mediterranean spirit. Walls are washed in natural pigment, floors are laid in stone, and the woodwork is left raw. Light reception rooms open to a kitchen made for long tables. There are five bedrooms, a master suite with study and dressing room, a cellar and a small spa. Outside, a long pool rests on level gardens of Mediterranean planting.

title: Maison des Collines
area: Near Pampelonne, open views over vineyards to the sea
features: Architect designed by a local studio
Wellness level with gym, hammam and sauna
Heated saltwater pool over sixteen metres
short: Low pale architecture laid into the Ramatuelle hills, looking across vines to a distant line of sea.
long: A long, low house drawn by a local architect, set so the land runs straight into the rooms. Wide glass frames the rolling hills, the vineyards of the Ramatuelle plain and, far off, the Mediterranean. Five suites, generous reception rooms and a quiet wellness level with hammam, sauna and cellar. Outside, terraces step down to a heated saltwater pool of more than sixteen metres, a pool house and the estate’s own rows of vines. Pampelonne lies a few minutes away.
source_agency: Côte d'Azur Sotheby's International Realty (also listed by Michaël Zingraf, MZIST1810)

title: Bastide du Ciel
area: Below the old village, panoramic views to the sea
type: Bastide with guest pavilion and caretaker house
features: Main house of about 230 square metres
Independent caretaker house of about 60 square metres
Pool with summer lounge and shaded pergola
short: An old bastide under umbrella pines near the village of Gassin, held between sky, hills and sea.
long: Just below the historic village of Gassin, an old bastide sits in more than a hectare of pine, cypress and green hillside, looking out across the hills to the sea. The main house holds a long living room, a dining room, a smaller salon and three bedrooms en suite. A guest pavilion around a patio adds two more, and a caretaker house stands further away. Terraces, a pool and a pergola wait in the garden. It asks for a careful renovation, and rewards it.

title: Villa Blanche
area: Domaine de la Garoupe, private gated estate near the beaches
short: A cream Belle Époque villa among the stone pines of the Garoupe estate, a short walk from the sea.
long: Inside the gated Domaine de la Garoupe, a few steps from its beaches, stands a Belle Époque villa of cream walls, deep balconies and slender columns, held by tall stone pines. Eleven rooms include spacious salons, a separate kitchen, a games room and seven bedrooms, each with its own bathroom. Below, a cellar for wine and another for champagne, a gym and a quiet spa. The garden falls gently to a pool screened by palms and old pines.
source_agency: Côte d'Azur Sotheby's International Realty (also listed by Michaël Zingraf, MZICP833)

title: Villa Lérins
area: La Californie, above the bay and the Lérins Islands
features: Main villa of about 565 square metres
Pool house of 150 square metres with gym, jacuzzi and summer kitchen
Dining room beneath a glass atrium
short: Terraced gardens high in La Californie, with the whole bay of Cannes and the Lérins Islands below.
long: High in La Californie, an enclosed estate of some eight thousand square metres looks over the whole bay of Cannes to the Lérins Islands and the red Esterel. The main villa holds wide salons, a dining room beneath a glass atrium and several suites. A pool house, a guest house and a caretaker apartment keep their own distance across the grounds. Terraces, a pergola and mature Mediterranean gardens step down to the pool. The Croisette is only minutes away.

title: L'Attique
area: Top floor of a gated residence, a walk from the village
features: Heated outdoor pool and indoor pool
Sauna, hammam, jacuzzi and fitness room
short: A quiet top floor apartment in Saint-Tropez, its terraces planted with olive and box, the village a stroll away.
long: On the top floor of a gated residence, within walking distance of the village, this apartment was entirely renewed in 2024 and is offered with its furniture. A pale reception room opens onto forty square metres of planted terraces. There are three bedrooms, one with a dressing room, and two bathrooms. Below lies a hectare of Mediterranean parkland, with an outdoor and an indoor pool, a small spa and a concierge. Restaurants and beaches are reached on foot.
source_agency: Côte d'Azur Sotheby's International Realty (also listed by Michaël Zingraf, MZIST1975)
